system.description: Driven by faith or fury, zealots press on through wounds that would stop a lesser warrior.

abilities.name: Frenzied
abilities.description: You can add 1 to this model's Attacks and Strength characteristics in a battle round in which they charged.

abilities.name: Exultant
abilities.description: Opponents must re-roll unmodified hit rolls of 6 for models from their kill team within 3" of this model, as long as it is not shaken.

rules.note: Opponents re-roll unmodified hit rolls of 6 for models within 3" of this model.

abilities.name: Flagellant
abilities.description: Roll a D6 each time this model loses a wound. On a 6 the wound is ignored.

abilities.name: Puritan
abilities.description: You can re-roll hit rolls in the Fight phase for this model against enemy models that do not have a Faction keyword in common with it.

abilities.name: Rousing
abilities.description: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of models from your kill team within 6" of this model, as long as it is not shaken.

abilities.name: Fanatical
abilities.description: This model automatically passes Nerve tests.

abilities.name: Strength of Spirit
abilities.description: Subtract 1 for Injury rolls made for this model.

tactics.name: Killing Frenzy
tactics.description: Use this Tactic when you pick a Zealot specialist from your kill team to fight in the Fight phase. Until the end of the phase, each time you make a hit roll of 6+ for that model you can make an additional attack with the same weapon against the same target. These attacks cannot themselves generate any further attacks.

tactics.name: Martyr
tactics.description: Use this Tactic when a Zealot specialist of Level 2 or higher from your kill team loses their last wound, before any player rolls on the Injury table.

tactics.name: Terrifying Rampage
tactics.description: Use this Tactic at the start of the Morale phase. Pick a Zealot specialist of Level 3 or higher from your kill team that took an enemy model out of action in the preceding Fight phase. Each enemy model within 6" of the Zealot must take a Nerve test. If the test is failed the model is shaken.
